name: 雷斯特·革末
bio_short: 美国物理学家. 他与克林顿·戴维森共同进行了著名的"戴维森-革末实验" (`davisson_germer_1927`), 首次观察到电子衍射, 证实了物质波的存在. 尽管贡献巨大, 他并未与戴维森分享诺贝尔奖.
bio_short_en: An American physicist. He co-conducted the famous 'Davisson-Germer experiment' (`davisson_germer_1927`) with Clinton Davisson, observing electron diffraction for the first time and confirming the existence of matter waves. Despite his contribution, he did not share the Nobel Prize with Davisson.
